meta.fill_model: trade-through limits only, spread paid on entry, both-hit bars booked as losses, 50% off at TP1 then a breakeven runner to TP2, time stop at the mode's hold limit
meta.disclaimer: Backtested on historical proxy data. Past performance is not a prediction and not a guarantee of future results.

validation.method: chronological 60/40 train/test split and split halves; the engine was not tuned on either part
